title: Base Modulus for Matroid Truncation, Strength, and Fractional Arboricity
summary: In [27], we provided results on the $p$-modulus of the family of all bases of matroids and showed that it recovers various concepts in matroid theory, including strength, fractional arboricity, and principal partitions. In particular, the unique optimal density $η^*$ that arises for $p$-modulus, which we will refer to as universal density from now on, was shown to recover the concept of lexicographical base in polymatroids.
